summary.text: Jeff Gallahan was elected to the New York State Assembly on November 3, 2020, and represents the 131st District, which includes parts of Ontario, Seneca, Cayuga, Cortland, Madison, Broome and Chenango counties.
His official biography says he previously served as Manchester town supervisor for 11 years and is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: According to his Assembly biography, Gallahan worked as a journeyman machinist at the General Railway Signal Company, then moved into cutting tool sales and took on management roles.
He served four years as a Manchester town councilman and then 11 years as town supervisor before his election to the Assembly.
He and his wife, Lynn, founded CR7 Food Trailer and Catering in 2017, the biography says.
He founded the Red Jacket High School trap shooting team and volunteers with the Sons of the American Legion and the Clifton Springs Area YMCA.
The biography lists his priorities as holding the line on taxes, ending bail reform measures and supporting small businesses and agriculture, and says he is a lifelong Ontario County resident.
